description: This file contains encoding functions including buffer encoding, XML string encoding, Base64 encoding and decoding, with internal helper functions and state management for encoding processes.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeToBuffer
methods.description: Encodes data into a buffer by copying bytes from source to destination buffer.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string into XML format, replacing special characters with entities, and returns the encoded length.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes data into Base64 format, managing state across multiple calls.

methods.name: HDK_EncodeBase64Done
methods.description: Finalizes Base64 encoding, adding padding if necessary, and returns the length of the final output.

methods.name: HDK_DecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes Base64 data, managing state across multiple calls, returning decoded length or error.

methods.name: HDK_DecodeBase64Done
methods.description: Checks if Base64 decoding process is complete based on state.
